outline:
本課程目的在增進學生英文學術寫作與口語簡報及討論能力，以適應全英語授課環境，內容包括多元化的學術寫作與口說練習活動，並由各類文本中分析並熟練英文句型結構及段落結構；亦包含簡報製作、內容架構以及實用線上資源應用等內容，以增強學生學術英文表達技巧。
This course is designed for undergraduate students to develop their academic English language skills for success in English-medium courses. Students will be engaged with active participation in a variety of academic writing and speaking activities that they would encounter in real-life academic university lectures and professional workplace environments. Students will also learn the structure, vocabulary, as well as strategies of delivering a successful presentation for academic purposes.

scorePolicy:
校內英文口說寫作檢定考Taipei Tech English Speaking and Writing Test (30%)

期中考Mid-Term: Essay/Writing (25%)
Throughout the first half of the semester, you will be writing an essay that will need to be handed in by week 9.

期末考Final: Presentation (25%)
In the second half of the semester, you will need to prepare a presentation of your essay and present it to the class. The presentations will be held on week 17 and 18.

課堂參與與練習In-class Participation(10%)
In class participation and discussion is required.

課程出席率Attendance(10%)
